name: Music from the Morning of the World
editorial_article: Released in 1967 as part of the Nonesuch Explorer Series, Music from the Morning of the World stands as the first stereo recording of traditional Balinese gamelan music. Produced by David Lewiston, the project captures diverse sounds from the island of Bali, featuring performances by regional ensembles. The collection was instrumental in introducing Western listeners to the complex interlocking rhythms and orchestral textures of Indonesian percussive music. As a central entry in the Nonesuch catalog, the recordings demonstrate the technical precision of Balinese orchestras, with the library of tracks emphasizing the sonic clarity possible with stereo field recording techniques during the late 1960s.
